newsitem.title: UK: Willis Corroon registers in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Willis Corroon registers in Japan.

text.p: Willis Corroon Group Plc said on Tuesday its Willis Corroon Japan Limited unit has become the first international insurance broker to register in Japan following a recent change in the law.

"The Japanese insurance market is undergoing radical change and deregulation which will present important opportunities for the industry to evolve," Michael Faber, chairman of Willis Corroon Japan, said in a statement.
"Willis Corroon Japan, in its new role as broker and risk management consultant, looks forward to making a positive contribution to the future of the insurance industry in Japan."
The company has been operating in Japan as a non-life insurance agency since February 1992.
A change in the Japanese Insurance Industry Law last year introduced the broker system.
A recent agreement between the U.S. and Japan is expected to open up the huge Japanese market to more overseas insurers in the coming years.
